user_intent: The operational camera will be mounted on the robot arm per its intended specification.

current_rc03_baseline.architecture: independent fixed overhead eye-to-hand camera fallback retained but not selected
current_rc03_baseline.note: The mast route remains an unqualified fallback only and is intentionally not selected because the user-confirmed final camera architecture is arm-mounted.

fixed_camera_fallback_release.note: The independent fixed-camera mast, feet, and universal plate are fallback-only. Route selection is not authorization; all four fallback print jobs remain blocked until a controlled camera decision explicitly releases this branch.

conflict: The user-confirmed arm-mounted intent conflicts with the currently controlled fixed-camera Step 13 workflow and system-level eye-to-hand assumptions. No exact arm-camera model, arm link/frame, mount drawing, or calibration contract was found in the current RC03 package.
required_before_geometry_or_instruction_: identify the exact camera manufacturer, model, lens, resolution, frame rate, serial interface, and mass
identify the exact robot link and coordinate frame carrying the camera
supply or measure the mount interface, fasteners, available envelope, center of mass, and cable exit
create controlled arm-mount CAD and collision geometry without inventing undocumented dimensions
include camera, mount, connector, and moving cable mass in the tool payload and reach analysis
define cable routing, strain relief, minimum relaxed bend, full-joint service loop, snag controls, and flex-life test
replace or formally supplement the fixed eye-to-hand calibration workflow with a validated eye-in-hand transform chain
define which board tags and tool/device features must be visible at each approach, hover, contact, and retreat pose
prove motion-dependent focus, exposure, blur, occlusion, calibration drift, and image timestamp synchronization
rerun IK, singularity, payload, collision, gravity-drop, and E-stop consequence analysis with the installed camera
revise Step 13, BOM, print jobs, assembly illustrations, software manifest, calibration schemas, acceptance gates, and checksums under formal change control
release_rule: Do not print an invented arm-camera adapter, install the camera on the arm, run camera-guided motion, or claim camera compatibility until the exact specification and all affected controlled artifacts are revised and validated.
